prompt_preview:
You are a consultant at Tessera Advisory (a fictional firm) writing a proposal deck for Falaj Health Partners on "Patient Experience and Clinical Operations Transformation".
Write the text for EXACTLY 16 slides, following each brief closely.
Rules:
- Confident consulting language in your OWN words.

slides.title: Patient Experience and Clinical Operations Transformation: proposal to Falaj Health Partners
bullets: Submitted by Tessera Advisory
October 2026
slides.notes: Opening slide for the proposal submission.

slides.title: About Tessera Advisory
bullets: We are a boutique firm specializing in operational health excellence.
Our firm holds ISO 27001 certification for information security.
Protecting data entrusted to us remains one of our core values.
slides.notes: Highlighting firm credentials and commitment to data security.

slides.title: Our understanding
bullets: Falaj Health Partners faces increasing pressure from rising patient expectations.
Current facilities are experiencing significant capacity constraints.
Persistent staff shortages continue to impact service delivery efficiency.
slides.notes: Setting the context based on current client challenges.

slides.title: Our approach
bullets: Listen: We capture the voice of your stakeholders to understand current pain points.
Measure: We leverage data to quantify operational performance and friction.
Design: We architect future-state processes and digital solutions.
Mobilise: We define the roadmap for successful implementation.

slides.title: Phase 1: Listen
bullets: Trace end-to-end care pathways across the sixteen hospitals and clinics.
Conduct sixty-plus sessions to gather feedback from patients, nurses, and physicians.
slides.notes: Detailed approach to gathering stakeholder insights.

slides.title: Phase 2: Measure
bullets: Quantify appointment delays and queue lengths for outpatient services.
Examine two years of historical records to identify operational trends.

slides.title: Phase 3: Design the digital experience
bullets: Recommend a robust online appointment booking platform.
Propose a dedicated patient mobile app to enhance user engagement.
slides.notes: Proposing digital tools to improve patient access.

slides.title: Phase 3: Design the workforce model
bullets: Develop a sophisticated rostering engine for clinical staff.
Align shift patterns with predicted patient demand to improve productivity.

slides.title: Programme leadership
bullets: Establish an executive steering board for high-level oversight.
Conduct monthly reviews of a balanced scorecard of performance indicators.
slides.notes: Defining the leadership structure for the program.

slides.title: Building capability
bullets: Launch a specialized training academy for nursing staff.
Focus development exclusively on the four hospitals within the network.
slides.notes: Focusing on nursing staff capability building.

slides.title: What you will receive
bullets: A baseline report on current patient experience and operational state.
A sequenced plan of initiatives prioritized for execution.
A live performance cockpit transferred to your internal technology team.

slides.title: Workplan
bullets: The total duration is 20 weeks.
Status notes provided every Thursday to the executive sponsor.
Mid-programme readout of results scheduled for week 10.

slides.title: Your team
bullets: Five dedicated experts with deep industry experience.
Includes a clinical advisor who served as a hospital chief medical officer for 15 years.
All team members are fully fluent in English and Arabic.

slides.title: Commercial proposal
bullets: Fixed fee structure for the entire engagement.
Payment schedule linked to specific project milestones.
Invoices payable within 30 days of contract award.

slides.title: Relevant experience
bullets: References from three healthcare clients available upon request.
Proprietary benchmarking database covering over 200 hospitals worldwide.
slides.notes: Demonstrating firm track record and proprietary assets.

slides.title: Why Tessera and next steps
bullets: Deep sector expertise tailored to your specific needs.
Proven methodologies that drive tangible operational outcomes.
Invitation to a follow-up meeting to discuss project alignment.
slides.notes: Closing value proposition and call to action.
